items.briefing:
A recent study highlighted in Security Brief Australia finds that AI-related security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a warning relevant to Australian businesses increasingly adopting AI tools. Separately, Troy Hunt's weekly data breach update serves as a reminder that personal and organisational data continues to be exposed globally, and Australian staff should stay alert to any notifications about compromised accounts.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an email or notification saying your account details may have been exposed in a data breach, change your password immediately and enable multi-factor authentication on that account.

featured.title: Origin Energy confirms customer data breach after unauthorised access
featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider Origin Energy confirms significant customer data breach affecting millions of Australians.
